attributes.during:
After you place your party's ship, make a fleet stack using 4 other ships that have been checked off your fleet card. Add 1d4 to your check to defeat a ship for each card in the fleet stack.

When you encounter a ship, summon but do not encounter 1d4+1 ships. The difficulty to defeat the original ship is increased by the total of the classes of the summoned ships. If you fail a check to defeat a ship, banish a ship from your fleet stack; if you can't, you lose the scenario.
attributes.locations: Cannibal Isle; Scar Bay; Pinnacle Atoll; Lonely Island; Fringes of the Eye; Raker Shoals; Shark Island; Coastline
attributes.name: The Armada
attributes.reward:
Each character draws a random non-Basic, non-Elite weapon from the box. Gain a Class 6 ship feat.

Loot: Crossbow of Retribution
